description: T1 item 10 (Repo hygiene). hygiene: README, LICENSE, the target spec, the environment doc and the CI workflows. checks: the audit commands CI runs, each of which exits non-zero on failure. evidence-inventories is the restricted run (--inventory) of scripts/check_evidence_inventories.py: the unrestricted run also compares the envelopes with the manifest, which an attestation is what refreshes. lint is `npm run lint` (check_records.py and the unrestricted inventory run included); it is local_only because the CI records job runs it on every push. It cannot be re-run while the manifest pins are being refreshed (it fails until the signoff-baseline record is re-minted, and that record cites this item's envelope), so re-mint this item FIRST on a tree whose baseline still holds (manifests/README.md).
